articles.author: Aidan  Stretch
articles.title: Photos show Ukraine's Starlink was throttled during Russian strike that killed 5 in park - CBS News
articles.description: Photos obtained by CBS News show Ukraine's vital connection to Starlink was throttled on Oct. 19, inhibiting its interception capacity when a deadly Russian strike hit a park.
